title: Ez wool
description: Now you can transform wool and carpets to strings :)
body:
# **Easy Wool**
The datapack you need! :)

## Why did I make it?
My idea was born when I attempted to make a string farm, but Mojang patched the duplication bug.
Then I thought it would be a good idea to create a datapack that adds a recipe to craft strings from any block of wool.

## A Useful Datapack
This datapack gives more value to your wool farm and provides an alternative use for the carpet duplication farm.

### RECIPES
1 block of wool → 4 strings

1 carpet → 2 strings

## Problems
To unlock the recipes, you need to craft them manually the first time, but I'm working on fixing this!

You can manually unlock the recipe with:

```
/recipe give @s ez_wool:wool_to_string
```

```
/recipe give @s ez_wool:carpet_to_string
```

## Support Me!
Comment below a version that doesn't exist yet, and I'll add it! ;)

**Thank you**,

Jon
